I am a 31-year-old woman farming in Lindi with only this small plot of cashew trees intercropped with cassava and beans. Chemical fertilizer is too expensive and difficult to find here on the coast, so I will not buy it. I have always used local cashew trees and saved my own cassava cuttings and bean seeds for planting. My family will do all the weeding, harvesting, and digging ourselves because the plot is small and we must save our money.
